title: Mixed Event — Stream With Friends♡ Wedding Live! — Episode5 Backstage at the Wedding Show

meta.Episode: Episode5 — Backstage at the Wedding Show
meta.Event Outline: Minori has started doing solo walking-tour streams as part of MORE MORE JUMP!'s activities. One day, she follows a viewer's recommendation to check out the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Line: Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, we ended up training a lot together and we both performed at the Fan Festival.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow, I didn't realize you two worked so hard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I knew that Hanasato was an incredible person, but so are you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, I'm really nothing special...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Everyone! I'm all ready!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...!
That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Minori, right?
Thank goodness. That means our thirty minutes are up.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Thanks, Nene and Minori's other friends!>
<We got to hear some good stories.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Nice work, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
I couldn't have done this without you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
But to be fair, all we really did was chat.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I guess it's time for Minori to dazzle us all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right.
Are you ready, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Ready!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for your patience!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line:
The newlywed bride, Minori Hanasato, will now enter!
I hope you'll all give her a big round of applause!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Look how I've transformed...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-How do I look?
Oh, lemme spin around for you♪ Haha.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That looks amazing on you!>
<Pink suits you really well.>
<You look so adorable. My eyes are starting to well up.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That does look really amazing on you, Hanasato...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree!
Oh, look at all the flowers on this dress. That's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And this color's perfect.
It really suits your sunny personality, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you do look amazing in it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm probably blushing like crazy from all this praise...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<No fair! I wanna try on a dress too!>
<I might try going there if I can.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Your viewers seem interested in actually coming here.
All because of your hard work, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so glad for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I've done hardly anything!
More importantly, I need to thank all of you for doing that segment while I was gone!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was fun!>
<I learned today that Minori is Minori wherever she goes.>
<You should do another segment like this again sometime.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I'm just glad we were able to help.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, now that I've changed into my dress, let's check out the next booth...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, on second thought...!
I'm sure you all have plans after this. Especially you, Nene. Don't you have to start getting ready for your show soon?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm actually free today, but what's this show you're talking about?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Nene's playing the lead in the show that's taking place later this evening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, that could be fun...
It might be worth seeing before heading home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I agree!
It'll be something we can tell the others about later.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm actually still free for about the next hour, but I will have to go once that time comes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry, I need to take this call.
It's Ms. Nozaki.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hello? This is Kusanagi.
Yes... Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?
Yes, of course. I'll try asking her now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Can we talk for a second, Hanasato?
Ms. Nozaki has a proposal for you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? A proposal?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, she was wondering if you'd like to stream us getting ready for our show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
B-But that's only for the staff to see, isn't it?! Is she sure about this?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes.
She said that she'd really appreciate it if you could include a sort of making-of segment...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd also like for everyone to see what goes on behind the scenes. The director and other cast members all worked really hard to make this show happen, after all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
In that case, I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, I'll let Ms. Nozaki know.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, but...
If I'm headed backstage, then doesn't that mean we have to sort of part ways for now...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right.
They don't need a bunch of outsiders getting in the way back there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm so sorry... After asking you all to help me, too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
We understand the position you're in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
So, Hanasato, let's meet again in the audience when the show starts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Thanks, everyone!>
<They seem like really nice girls.>
<Bye bye!>
Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, this is the rehearsal room for the show! Can you guys see everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Whoa, look at all the cast members!>
<I've never seen anything like this before!>
<Do you spend a lot of time in these kinds of places, Nene?>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm seeing a lot of dresses and tuxedos. Are they all costumes?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
This show's about a wedding, so I guess it's natural for dresses and tuxedos to... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Why do these ones have wings on them...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, those costumes are for everyone playing the angels.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The angels?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, the wedding angels.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Actually, that probably isn't very helpful...
So, mind if I gave you a brief overview of the story?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, please!
Take it away.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Today's performance is titled “The Happy Wedding Show,” and its theme revolves around putting together the happiest wedding possible in the style that you want.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My character, the protagonist, isn't sure at first if she even wants to hold a wedding at all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's when the wedding angels, the patrons of marriages, appear before her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She gradually begins to change her mind as they show her various examples of different ceremonies.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Wait, examples of different ceremonies... Does that include the train wedding and the one at the aquarium we talked about earlier today?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: At the end, she's reminded of something very important when she sees a wedding take place at a live house.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something very important...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's reminded of how she met her fiancé.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She met him when she went to see a concert for this one idol. After remembering what happened, she decides to have her wedding at a live house.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She decides to have her wedding at a live house because of that idol's concert...?! That's so beautiful!!!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Marrying someone you met at a concert! Talk about living the dream!>
<The wedding itself would probably feel like a concert too after inviting all your friends!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you guys mean!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, that's about how the story goes for this show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks, Nene!
I feel even more excited about seeing it now♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: I'm also glad to hear you say that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! Oh, and this is...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, this is Mr. Okamura. He's the director of our show.

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line:
It's a pleasure to meet you.
And thank you for advertising our show like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, thank you for coming over to talk to us!
My name is Minori Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Again, I'm very much looking forward to seeing the show!

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it.
This show was built around the idea of showing everyone just how much fun weddings are. I hope that message comes across clearly.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How much fun weddings are...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Have you noticed how fewer and fewer young people are holding weddings these days?

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Of course, they're all free to choose whether or not to actually have one. It's perfectly fine to decide against.

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: But I fear that some of them will look back in regret by the time they've turned my age. That they missed an opportunity to share their happiness with others...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Of course, the financial aspect can become a source of stress for many, but deciding against it without understanding what they have to offer seems like a bit of a shame.

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Which is why I want us to show just how much fun weddings are. So, Ms. Kusanagi, let's do our best today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Mr. Okamura, Ms. Nozaki and Nene all feel the same way.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They want everyone watching to see that weddings are fun. Even just a little bit.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Now I'm more excited about seeing it!

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line:
That's wonderful to hear.
Now, the rest of us need to make our final preparations...
se_run_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: W-We have an emergency, Mr. Okamura...!

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Hm? Slow down. What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: It's one of the cast members. She tripped, and...

rows.Speaker: Minori & Nene
rows.Line: What...?!
